title: Rabbi Ba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says that almost all the Amoraim called Rabbi Abba in the Babylonian Talmud are called “Rabbi Ba” in the Jerusalem Talmud, in abbreviated form. He likewise says that the Zohar always has Rabbi Ba, meaning Rabbi Abba.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The “almost all” and “always” assertions belong to Hyman’s general explanation of the Ba/Abba name forms; they are not a new exhaustive corpus count or a rule automatically binding identities.

A full Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:5 paragraph names Rabbi Ba son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba. This is an attestation of the Ba form, not proof that it equals a particular Bavli Abba. Hyman’s “almost all” and Zohar “always” statements remain his general claims; no exhaustive corpus comparison or fresh Zohar witness is asserted.
